title: Exactness of the doubly nonnegative relaxation for qubit-output quantum channels
summary: The resource theory for nonnegativity of quantum amplitudes distinguishes completely positive completely positive (CPCP) quantum channels from the larger class of completely positive doubly nonnegative (CPDNN) quantum channels. Johnston and Sikora showed that all qubit-to-qubit quantum channels that are CPDNN are also CPCP. However, they left open the question of whether a qutrit-to-qubit quantum channel exists that is CPDNN but not CPCP.
